title: SQL
learner_context: I am new to SQL and want to query a real database confidently: SELECT and filtering, joins across several tables, GROUP BY and aggregates, subqueries and CTEs, NULL handling, and how to tell a correct query from one that merely runs. Practical work against PostgreSQL, with real examples I can type. Not database administration, not schema design theory, not the history of the standard.

concepts.title: SELECT Clause Syntax
learning_objectives: Recall the syntactic position of the SELECT clause within a SQL statement.
Identify the purpose of the SELECT clause in specifying result columns.

concepts.title: WHERE Clause Syntax
learning_objectives: Recall the syntactic position of the WHERE clause within a SQL statement.
Identify the purpose of the WHERE clause in filtering rows.

concepts.title: Comparison Operators List
learning_objectives: Recall the set of standard comparison operators in SQL.
Identify the function of equality and inequality operators.

concepts.title: Equality Operator Mechanics
learning_objectives: Recall the syntax for the equality operator.
Identify the result of comparing a value to NULL using equality.

concepts.title: Greater Than Operator Mechanics
learning_objectives: Recall the syntax for the greater than operator.
Identify the result of comparing a value to NULL using greater than.

concepts.title: Aggregate Function Categories
learning_objectives: Explain how aggregate functions process multiple rows into a single scalar value.
Distinguish between row-level and set-level processing in SQL execution.

concepts.title: Standard Aggregate Functions
learning_objectives: Identify the specific behavior of COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, and MAX.
Predict output differences when aggregating numeric versus character data types.

concepts.title: NULL Handling in Aggregates
learning_objectives: Describe how NULL values are handled by standard aggregate functions.
Explain why COUNT(*) differs from COUNT(column_name) regarding NULLs.

concepts.title: GROUP BY Clause Logic
learning_objectives: Define the logical role of the GROUP BY clause in transforming result sets.
Map input rows to output groups based on unique column combinations.

concepts.title: Multi-Column Grouping
learning_objectives: Construct queries grouping by single and multiple columns.
Predict the structure of output rows when grouping by multiple attributes.

concepts.title: SELECT List Grouping Constraints
learning_objectives: Explain the restriction on non-aggregated columns in SELECT lists.
Identify why SELECT must align with GROUP BY keys or aggregates.

lessons.title: HAVING Clause and Query Execution Order

concepts.title: HAVING vs WHERE Timing
learning_objectives: Differentiate between WHERE and HAVING in terms of execution timing.
Explain why WHERE cannot filter on aggregate results.

concepts.title: Filtering Aggregated Groups
learning_objectives: Construct HAVING clauses using aggregate expressions.
Predict results when filtering groups based on calculated thresholds.

concepts.title: SQL Execution Pipeline Order
learning_objectives: Analyze the logical order of operations involving GROUP BY and HAVING.
Trace query execution flow from filtering rows to filtering groups.

concepts.title: NULLs in Group Keys
learning_objectives: Explain the behavior of GROUP BY with NULL values in grouping columns.
Predict how NULLs are treated as a single group identity.

concepts.title: NULLs in Group Values
learning_objectives: Describe the impact of NULLs on aggregate calculations within groups.
Distinguish between empty groups and groups with only NULLs.

concepts.title: Mixed NULL Group Behavior
learning_objectives: Analyze query results when grouping columns contain mixed NULLs and values.
Explain why COUNT(*) includes NULL rows while COUNT(col) excludes them.

concepts.title: Post-Aggregation Sorting
learning_objectives: Explain the role of the ORDER BY clause in post-aggregation sorting.
Distinguish between sorting groups and sorting within groups.

concepts.title: Ordering by Aggregates
learning_objectives: Construct queries ordering by aggregate results.
Predict output order when sorting by non-grouped aggregates.
concepts.withheld_reason: says NULLs sort FIRST under ASC; the engine puts them LAST

concepts.title: HAVING and ORDER BY Interaction
learning_objectives: Analyze the interaction between HAVING filters and ORDER BY results.
Explain why ORDER BY applies after HAVING filtering.

concepts.title: Aggregation Performance Characteristics
learning_objectives: Explain the performance implications of unnecessary GROUP BY usage.
Identify when aggregation forces a full table scan versus index usage.

concepts.title: Execution Plan Differences
learning_objectives: Analyze query plans for simple aggregations versus grouped aggregations.
Predict execution differences between COUNT(*) and COUNT(DISTINCT col).

concepts.title: Optimizer Aggregation Pushdown
learning_objectives: Explain how database optimizers handle aggregate pushdowns.
Identify scenarios where HAVING cannot be pushed below GROUP BY.

concepts.title: Join Condition Mechanics
learning_objectives: Explain how the database engine matches rows between two tables based on a specified condition.
Distinguish between the result set of an equi-join and a non-equi-join.

concepts.title: Inner Join Syntax
learning_objectives: Describe the process of combining rows from two tables where the join condition evaluates to true.
Predict the output when no matching rows exist in either table.

concepts.title: Explicit JOIN Syntax
learning_objectives: Identify the role of the ON clause in defining relationship criteria versus the WHERE clause in filtering.
Construct a query joining two tables using explicit INNER JOIN syntax.

concepts.title: Left Outer Join Logic
learning_objectives: Define the behavior of a left outer join when a match is found in the right table.
Define the behavior of a left outer join when no match is found in the right table.

concepts.title: Preserved Row Logic in OUTER JOINs
learning_objectives: Explain how NULL values are generated for non-matching columns in the preserved table.
Differentiate between the preserved table and the filtered table in a left join.

concepts.title: Outer Join Comparison
learning_objectives: Analyze how a left join differs from an inner join regarding row count and NULLs.
Select the appropriate join type to retrieve all records from one table regardless of matches.

concepts.title: Multi-Table Join Chaining
learning_objectives: Describe the logical order of operations when multiple tables are joined in a single query.
Identify how join conditions interact with WHERE filters in the query execution plan.

concepts.title: Table Aliasing in JOINs
learning_objectives: Explain the concept of table aliases in simplifying column references across joined tables.
Construct a query joining three tables using alias prefixes for disambiguation.

concepts.title: Complex Join Structures
learning_objectives: Predict the result of a join chain where one intermediate join yields no matches.
Debug common errors related to ambiguous column names in multi-table joins.

concepts.title: Cartesian Product (CROSS JOIN)
learning_objectives: Explain how a join condition restricts the Cartesian product of two tables.
Calculate the potential size of a result set before applying join filters.

concepts.title: Key-Based Join Conditions
learning_objectives: Describe the role of primary and foreign keys in defining valid join conditions.
Identify the difference between natural joins and equi-joins on key columns.

concepts.title: Join
learning_objectives: Analyze the impact of duplicate keys in join columns on result set cardinality.
Predict row multiplication effects when joining on non-unique columns.

concepts.title: Join Optimization
learning_objectives: Explain how the database engine optimizes join order for performance.
Identify factors that influence the choice of join algorithm (e.g., hash, merge).

concepts.title: Index Impact on Joins
learning_objectives: Describe the impact of missing indexes on join columns on query execution time.
Analyze how join type (inner vs outer) affects optimization strategies.

concepts.title: Join Algorithm Selection
learning_objectives: Compare the performance characteristics of nested loop joins versus hash joins.
Predict when a join might result in a full table scan.

concepts.title: Debugging Join Errors
learning_objectives: Explain how to debug unexpected NULLs in a join result set.
Identify common mistakes in join condition syntax that lead to incorrect results.

concepts.title: Syntax Best Practices
learning_objectives: Describe the difference between implicit and explicit join syntax in terms of readability.
Convert an implicit join (comma-separated tables) to an explicit JOIN clause.

concepts.title: Data Type Compatibility
learning_objectives: Analyze how to handle data type mismatches in join columns.
Predict errors arising from comparing incompatible data types in join conditions.

concepts.title: Scalar Subqueries in Filters
learning_objectives: Construct a nested query to filter rows based on a single aggregated value from a related table.
Apply scalar subqueries in the WHERE clause to replace complex join logic for one-to-many lookups.

concepts.title: Correlated Subquery Mechanics
learning_objectives: Evaluate the execution order of correlated subqueries against uncorrelated subqueries in filtering contexts.
Debug common syntax errors involving column ambiguity in nested WHERE clauses.

concepts.title: Existence Testing with EXISTS
learning_objectives: Implement EXISTS and NOT EXISTS predicates to test for row existence without retrieving data.
Optimize filter performance by choosing between EXISTS and standard equality joins.

concepts.title: Derived Table Construction
learning_objectives: Write a subquery in the FROM clause to generate a derived table for aggregation.
Apply column aliases to derived tables to ensure valid reference in outer query scopes.

concepts.title: Nested Derived Tables
learning_objectives: Design nested derived tables to perform multi-stage aggregation without intermediate views.
Analyze the logical query processing order to predict column availability in outer SELECT lists.

concepts.title: Derived Table Performance
learning_objectives: Compare performance characteristics of derived tables versus temporary tables for intermediate results.
Refactor a complex join query into a derived table structure for improved readability.

concepts.title: Scalar Subqueries in SELECT
learning_objectives: Use scalar subqueries in the SELECT list to return a single value per row.
Handle NULL results from scalar subqueries when no matching row exists in the inner query.

concepts.title: Correlated Scalar Calculations
learning_objectives: Construct correlated scalar subqueries to compute row-level metrics against aggregate baselines.
Apply scalar subqueries to calculate running totals or comparisons against group averages.

concepts.title: Scalar Subquery Optimization
learning_objectives: Identify scenarios where scalar subqueries cause performance degradation due to repeated execution.
Rewrite scalar subqueries as JOINs or window functions for optimized execution plans.

concepts.title: Pre-Aggregation Derived Tables
learning_objectives: Construct a subquery in the FROM clause to pre-aggregate data before joining.
Apply derived tables to simplify complex join conditions by isolating aggregation logic.

concepts.title: Nested Aggregation Patterns
learning_objectives: Design nested derived tables to perform sequential filtering and aggregation steps.
Validate column references in outer queries against the scope of inner derived tables.

concepts.title: Derived Table Join Optimization
learning_objectives: Compare execution plans of derived table joins versus direct multi-table joins.
Optimize query performance by pushing predicates into derived tables where possible.

concepts.title: Per-Row Aggregate Comparisons
learning_objectives: Use scalar subqueries in the SELECT list to compute per-row values against global aggregates.
Apply scalar subqueries to calculate percentage of total or deviation from mean.

concepts.title: Correlated Scalar Logic
learning_objectives: Construct correlated scalar subqueries to reference outer query columns in inner calculations.
Debug scope resolution errors when referencing outer columns in nested scalar subqueries.

concepts.title: Scalar vs Window Functions
learning_objectives: Evaluate the performance impact of scalar subqueries in the SELECT list versus window functions.
Refactor scalar subqueries to window functions for improved efficiency in large datasets.

concepts.title: Mixed Subquery Composition
learning_objectives: Combine WHERE, FROM, and SELECT subqueries in a single complex query.
Apply logical query processing order to debug mixed subquery structures.

concepts.title: Subquery Optimization Strategies
learning_objectives: Optimize a complex query by identifying redundant subqueries and replacing them with joins.
Analyze execution plans to detect inefficient subquery execution patterns.

concepts.title: Subquery Best Practices
learning_objectives: Write maintainable subquery structures using consistent aliasing and indentation.
Apply best practices for documenting complex subquery logic for team collaboration.

concepts.title: Basic CTE Syntax
learning_objectives: Construct a basic Common Table Expression (CTE) using the WITH clause to replace a derived table in a FROM clause.
Refactor a nested subquery into a named CTE to improve readability and maintainability of a SELECT statement.

concepts.title: CTE Scoping Rules
learning_objectives: Identify the scoping limitations of a CTE relative to the main query block.
Apply a CTE within a JOIN condition to pre-filter a dataset before joining.

concepts.title: CTE Execution Behavior
learning_objectives: Differentiate between the execution behavior of a standard CTE and a derived table.
Evaluate when a CTE might prevent query optimization compared to a subquery.

concepts.title: Recursive CTE Structure
learning_objectives: Define a recursive CTE structure by specifying the anchor member and the recursive member.
Construct a recursive CTE to generate a sequence of integers from 1 to 100.

concepts.title: Hierarchical Data Traversal
learning_objectives: Design a recursive CTE to traverse a hierarchical employee reporting structure.
Calculate the depth level of each node in a tree structure using a recursive CTE.

concepts.title: Recursive CTE Safety
learning_objectives: Detect infinite loops in recursive CTEs caused by missing termination conditions.
Apply MAXRECURSION hint to limit recursion depth and prevent resource exhaustion.

concepts.title: CTE Chaining Mechanics
learning_objectives: Chain multiple CTEs in a single WITH clause where each CTE references a previous one.
Construct a multi-step data transformation pipeline using chained CTEs.

concepts.title: CTE Chaining Performance
learning_objectives: Compare the performance of a CTE chain versus a nested derived table approach.
Optimize a complex query by breaking it into logical CTE steps for better readability.

concepts.title: Mixed CTE Patterns
learning_objectives: Combine recursive and non-recursive CTEs in a single query block.
Apply a non-recursive CTE to filter data before feeding it into a recursive CTE.

concepts.title: Multiple Aggregations
learning_objectives: Apply a CTE to solve a problem requiring multiple aggregations on the same dataset.
Construct a query using two CTEs that each perform a different aggregate function on the same base table.

concepts.title: Window Function Integration
learning_objectives: Use a CTE to calculate a running total that requires window functions.
Compare the readability of a CTE-based running total versus a correlated subquery.

concepts.title: Conditional Aggregation
learning_objectives: Implement a CTE to handle conditional aggregation logic.
Apply a CTE to pivot data from rows to columns using conditional sums.

concepts.title: Graph Traversal
learning_objectives: Design a recursive CTE to solve a graph traversal problem with weighted edges.
Apply a recursive CTE to find the shortest path between two nodes in a graph.

concepts.title: Date Generation
learning_objectives: Use a recursive CTE to generate a calendar table for date-based analysis.
Apply a recursive CTE to fill in missing dates in a time series dataset.

concepts.title: Data Parsing
learning_objectives: Construct a recursive CTE to parse hierarchical configuration data.
Apply a recursive CTE to flatten a nested JSON structure into relational rows.

concepts.title: CTE vs Temp Table
learning_objectives: Identify scenarios where a CTE is more efficient than a temporary table.
Apply a CTE to optimize a query that requires multiple passes over the same data.

concepts.title: CTE Performance Tuning
learning_objectives: Analyze the execution plan of a CTE to identify potential performance bottlenecks.
Apply indexing strategies to support CTE-based queries.

concepts.title: CTE Debugging
learning_objectives: Debug a CTE that returns unexpected results due to scoping issues.
Apply best practices for naming and documenting CTEs in complex queries.

concepts.title: Three-Valued Logic Mechanics
learning_objectives: Distinguish between the three-valued logic states (True, False, Unknown) in SQL predicate evaluation.
Analyze why the equality operator (=) fails to identify NULL values compared to explicit null checks.

concepts.title: Explicit Null Detection Operators
learning_objectives: Trace the evaluation path of IS NULL and IS NOT NULL operators within WHERE clauses.
Compare the logical outcomes of comparing NULL with numeric literals versus string literals.

concepts.title: NULL Propagation in Expressions
learning_objectives: Identify how NULL propagates through arithmetic expressions (addition, multiplication) and aggregate functions.
Analyze the impact of NULLs on the result set size when filtering with standard comparison operators.

lessons.title: NULL Behavior in Aggregation and Sorting

concepts.title: NULLs in Grouping and Distinct
learning_objectives: Examine how NULLs behave as distinct values in GROUP BY operations versus unique sets.
Analyze the interaction between NULLs and the DISTINCT keyword in result sets.

concepts.title: NULLs in Sorting and Joining
learning_objectives: Evaluate how NULLs affect the ordering of results in ORDER BY clauses (NULLS FIRST/LAST).
Analyze the logical implications of NULLs in JOIN ON conditions versus WHERE filters.

concepts.title: COALESCE and Default Substitution
learning_objectives: Construct queries using COALESCE to substitute NULLs with default values for display.
Analyze the performance and logical differences between COALESCE and CASE WHEN NULL handling.

concepts.title: Debugging NULL-Related Filter Errors
learning_objectives: Debug queries by isolating predicates that silently filter out rows due to NULL comparisons.
Analyze execution plans to identify hidden NULL-related logical errors in complex WHERE clauses.

concepts.title: Query Validation with Edge Cases
learning_objectives: Validate query logic by testing edge cases involving empty sets and NULL inputs.
Analyze the correctness of scalar subqueries that may return NULL instead of a row.

concepts.title: Testing NULL Propagation Paths
learning_objectives: Design test cases that specifically target NULL propagation paths in calculated columns.
Analyze the difference between logical NULL and empty string ('') in validation contexts.

concepts.title: Logical Equivalence of Null Checks
learning_objectives: Analyze the logical difference between IS UNKNOWN and IS NULL in boolean contexts.
Evaluate how NULLs in join keys affect the cardinality of outer join results.

concepts.title: Subqueries and Null Outer References
learning_objectives: Trace the execution of correlated subqueries where the outer reference is NULL.
Analyze the behavior of EXISTS vs NOT EXISTS when dealing with NULL-producing subqueries.

concepts.title: NULLs in Indexing and Optimization
learning_objectives: Identify scenarios where NULLs in index columns prevent index usage.
Analyze the optimizer's handling of NULLs in filter predicates for performance.

concepts.title: NULLIF for Logical Equivalence
learning_objectives: Construct queries using NULLIF to prevent division by zero and handle logical equivalence.
Analyze the logical outcome of NULLIF when comparing identical non-NULL values.

concepts.title: NULLs in Recursive CTEs
learning_objectives: Design CTEs that explicitly handle NULL states in recursive steps.
Analyze the termination conditions of recursive CTEs when NULLs are introduced.

concepts.title: NULLs in Window Functions
learning_objectives: Evaluate the use of NULLS FIRST/LAST in window function partitions.
Analyze how NULLs affect the ranking and framing in window calculations.

concepts.title: Data Integrity and Null Constraints
learning_objectives: Validate data integrity by checking for unexpected NULLs in primary key columns.
Analyze the logical implications of NULLs in foreign key constraints.

concepts.title: Debugging Aggregate NULL Sources
learning_objectives: Debug queries that produce unexpected NULLs in calculated aggregates.
Analyze the source of NULLs in multi-table joins using set operations.

concepts.title: Cross-Dialect NULL Validation
learning_objectives: Create test suites that verify NULL handling across different SQL dialects.
Analyze the portability of NULL handling logic in cross-database applications.
